pr_title: Bluetooth: shell: Add examples for the Bluetooth Shell
pr_body:
Add examples for the Bluetooth Shell on common use cases.

Also, update the help of some Bluetooth Shell commands to be more consistent.

Link to the compiled documentation: https://builds.zephyrproject.io/zephyr/pr/54124/docs/connectivity/bluetooth/bluetooth-shell.html

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/54529
pr_comments: @theob-pro Could you open a bug issue briefly describing the problem that the commit "Bluetooth: Small fixes for some Bluetooth Shell commands" is fixing and link to this PR since we have been requiring bug issue for other bug-fix PRs?

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: shell: Missing help messages and parameters

review_comments: seems this should be in a different commit. or just update the commit message, but it's a functional change not just help text.
